aluminum_quenching_1_subtask_structure_r.name: Aluminum Structure Retrieval for Quenching - Level 1
aluminum_quenching_1_subtask_structure_r.description: Retrieve structure of Aluminum and convert it to LAMMPs data format. Return the absolute path of the final structure.

aluminum_quenching_1_subtask_potential_f.name: Aluminum Potential File for Quenching - Level 1
aluminum_quenching_1_subtask_potential_f.description: Procure the appropriate Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential file for Aluminum for MD simulations. Return the absolute path to the potential file.

aluminum_quenching_1_subtask_quenching.name: Aluminum NPT Quenching - Level 1
aluminum_quenching_1_subtask_quenching.description: Given paths to LAMMPs compatible Aluminum molten structure file and EAM potential file appropriate for MD simulations, simulate the quenching process of the system by cooling it under NPT. Detect the glass transition temperature (Tg) as the temperature at which the slope of density versus temperature changes. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
